title: Credit Card Debt
description: Bank credit-card balances, plus the same balances held against M2 growth.
summary: This is what households owe on bank credit cards and other revolving plans. The white line is the actual dollar pile. The orange line holds that pile still against M2 growth, using 2000-06-28 as the starting money-supply level. If card balances and the money supply grow at the same speed, orange stays flat. The 2010 jump is mostly accounting — banks brought card loans back onto the balance sheet — not a sudden borrowing binge.
